competitors.name: CAULIPOWER
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported CAULIPOWER debuted High Protein Supreme Pizza, using a Greek yogurt and cauliflower gluten-free crust with 42 grams of protein and 6 grams of fiber. The pizza is launching nationwide at Walmart in August at an $8.26 suggested retail price, with additional retailers planned; CAULIPOWER is also adding a Whole Foods-exclusive limited-time Sweater Weather pizza from Sept. 2 to Nov. 3.

competitors.name: PORTA
competitors.action: Foodbevy reported PORTA launched handmade Roman-style frozen pizzas at Target stores nationwide and online, increasing its U.S. retail footprint to 4,500 doors. The rollout includes Pepperoni, Margherita, Mushroom & Fontina, and Sweet & Spicy Soppressata pizzas at $11.99, made with 100% Italian flour and 24-hour slow-fermented dough.

competitors.name: TAST!EZ / McCain Foods USA
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported McCain Foods USA's TAST!EZ brand launched Flavor-Fulls, frozen snacks with cheese- and sauce-filled centers. Varieties include Mini Marinara Mozzarella Sticks, Mini Creamy Garlic Mozzarella Sticks, and Cheddar & Bacon Potato Bites, now available at select retailers nationwide including Walmart and Wakefern stores at $4.99 per 11-ounce box.

trends.context: A direct frozen-pizza competitor is pairing gluten-free crust cues with a high-protein claim and Walmart distribution, raising the functional-nutrition bar in frozen pizza.
